name: Sword of Arthur
review:
Arthurian legend on a 3x5 grid with 10 lines. In free spins, expanding symbols combine with a rising multiplier, and a Power Reset feature adds tension as you wonder whether the multiplier will hold.

The base game is quiet, so the bonus is really the whole game here. Very high volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.34%, below average, so try it in demo before playing for real.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
